Exact change of variables t_i=logcosh|y_i| produces the Dirichlet(1/2,...,1/2,1) expectation; G(t)=e^{t/2}sqrt(t/sinh t) has 1<G(t)<e^{t/2}. The moment identities ES=2/(n+2) and EΣT_i²=3n/[(n+2)(n+4)] and Taylor logG=t/2−t²/12+O(t⁴) imply correction −(1/n+1/(4n))=−5/(4n). Independently evaluated the exact two-dimensional integral (ratio 1.2680315364) and checked finite-size symbolic moments as diagnostics, not as proof. The limits p→∞ at fixed n and n→∞ of the limiting body are explicitly kept separate.
